artists.biography: Awooga started in late 2008 jamming away in a cold little decrepit practice room in Sheffield city centre across from a 86 year old Master Steel Forger who once made knives for Bill Clinton and Elvis Presley. No lie, he showed us the photos. Our sound is heavy, melodic and atmospheric. It's a bit proggy and we have been told " you guys sound like a star exploding". Have a listen. We have played with some really good bands in the past and still do now such as Saviours, Kruger, Downslide, and many more that we have been privileged to share bills with in the past. http://www.myspace.com/awoogalol Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Conduit is a seven-track rock album by Sheffield-based band Awooga, released on April 20, 2018, through Rockosmos. The album spans 40 minutes and features the tracks "Temporal," "Tabula Rasa," "Waterhole," "Blue Rose," "Bandit," "Witness," and "Otherside," with production by Iago Lorenzo and mastering by Robin Schmidt. The record showcases the band's approach to arrangement and dynamic shifts, with critics noting the "arrangements and explosions of volume, expertly woven" throughout the material.

Within Awooga's discography, Conduit represents a significant evolutionary step for the band, demonstrating their continued artistic development in the rock and indie landscape. The album's construction reflects meticulous attention to sonic detail, with the band and producer investing considerable effort into achieving the album's distinctive sound. The extended runtime of the closing track "Witness," which stretches to over 11 minutes, suggests the band's willingness to explore extended compositional forms alongside more concise song structures.

The album received recognition from established music publications, with both Kerrang and Metal Hammer acknowledging its place in the band's progression. Conduit was released across multiple formats, including vinyl and CD editions, establishing its presence in the physical music market and reflecting the band's commitment to traditional album presentation during the streaming era.
